name: secret-guard
description: Hides secrets in tool results before Claude reads them: the secret values of every .env and .env.* from your session's folder up to the drive root, and anything that looks like a secret (KEY=VALUE under a secret name, passwords in URLs, private keys, JWTs, AWS keys, Kubernetes Secrets); tells Claude how to use them without printing them

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: value: hide secrets found in tool results and refuse commands that print a whole env file or a decrypted secret. command: refuse any call whose input names a protected env file (except to load it), without reading values.

secretFiles.title: Secret files
secretFiles.description: Comma-separated globs of env files to read. A file name is looked for from the session's folder up to the drive root; a path (~/vault/**/.env) is read where it points; !glob leaves files out.

secretKeys.title: Secret keys
secretKeys.description: Comma-separated key names to treat as secrets on top of the built-in rule (a part of the name is PASS, PASSWD, PASSWORD, PW, PWD, SECRET, TOKEN, KEY, DSN, CREDENTIAL or PRIVATE).

identifierKeys.title: Identifier keys
identifierKeys.description: Comma-separated key names that hold names, not secrets (KMS_KEY_ID, a login name); never hidden.
